formula.name: Green Patchouli Cologne V4 — Citrus Patchouli Chypre
formula.body:
### STEP 1 — BASE (add first, swirl after every 3)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 1 | Patchouli EO | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 2 | Nagarmortha Oil | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 3 | Clearwood | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 4 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 5 | Ambrox Super | 30% w/v | 300 | 0.300 |
| 6 | Vetiver EO | neat | 280 | 0.280 |
| 7 | Romandolide | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 8 | Cedramber | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 9 | Ethylene Brassylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 10 | Habanolide | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 11 | Coumarin | 20% in EtOH | 150 | 0.150 |
| 12 | Evernyl | neat | 25 | 0.025 |

**Base subtotal: 2,965 µL**

---

### STEP 2 — HEART (add second, swirl after each)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 12 | Hedione | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 13 | Iso E Super | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 14 | Lavender EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 15 | Geraniol | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 16 | Vanillin | 10% in DPG | 300 | 0.300 |
| 17 | Dihydrojasmone | neat | 60 | 0.060 |
| 18 | Azarbre | neat | 30 | 0.030 |
| 19 | Frankincense EO | neat | 60 | 0.060 |

**Heart subtotal: 1,550 µL**

---

### STEP 3 — TOP (add last, work quickly, cap immediately)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 19 | Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian | neat | 400 | 0.400 |
| 20 | Grapefruit FCF | neat | 120 | 0.120 |
| 21 | Petitgrain EO | neat | 50 | 0.050 |
| 22 | Black Pepper EO | neat | 80 | 0.080 |
| 23 | Cardamom EO | neat | 30 | 0.030 |

**Top subtotal: 680 µL**

---

### STEP 4 — ETHANOL

| # | Material | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----|----|
| 24 | Ethanol 96% | 24,805 | 24.805 |

**Concentrate: 5,195 µL (17.3%) · Total: 30,000 µL · 30 mL · 24 materials**

---

## MUSK SWAP RATIONALE

| Musk | In V3 | In V4 | Effect |
|------|-------|-------|--------|
| Galaxolide 50% | 700 µL | — | Removed. Laundry-clean projection fights dark chypre |
| Romandolide | 250 µL | 250 µL | Kept. Woody-clean luxury — the "your skin" musk |
| **Ethylene Brassylate** | — | **300 µL** | Added. Creamy lactonic depth — supports Vanillin-patchouli axis. Substantivity 0.92 |
| **Habanolide** | — | **200 µL** | Added. Translucent warm skin veil. VP=0.1 Pa |

Combined effect: "expensive dark skin" instead of "clean laundry."

---

*V4 — musks replaced for darkness + creaminess. All materials verified against inventory.txt.*

diagnostics: ℹ Dense lipophilic base — deep skin absorption, slow evolution
Blooming materials (Iso-E-effect): Patchouli EO, Patchouli EO, Clearwood, Clearwood, Benzyl Salicylate
Perceptual channels: 17 (8 cross-adaptation groups + 9 solo materials) from 25 ingredients
Channel model: 16 materials collapsed into 8 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• musk: Habanolide, Ethylene Brassylate, Romandolide (3 → 1 channel)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Clearwood, Ambrox Super (3 → 1 channel)
• citrus_terpene: Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF (2 → 1 channel)
Genetic anosmia risk: 1.9% of formula mass affected by OR variants
✓ All profiled materials within positive character range
ℹ Near character-shift boundary: Hedione, Iso E Super — small dose changes could shift perceived character
Far-field: Lavender EO, Geraniol, Dihydrojasmone, Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF
Mid-field: Patchouli EO, Clearwood, Ambrox Super, Vetiver EO, Cedramber
Near-field: Benzyl Salicylate, Romandolide, Ethylene Brassylate, Habanolide, Vanillin

  2. Dissolve Vanillin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.
